# Agent HUD 0.4.39-beta.2
## Compatibility
**Requires Agent HUD for iPhone 1.5 or later** for iPhone and Apple Watch sync. Update the iPhone app before updating the Mac. Older iPhone versions cannot read this release's data.
[Get the iPhone app](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812113619).
If the required iPhone version is not yet on the App Store, cross-device features require the corresponding TestFlight version.
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
## Changes
- Improves LAN snapshot updates by computing canonical record IDs once before sorting snapshots and replay batches. This removes repeated encoding from the sorting hot path. - Recognises personal SuperGrok accounts whose native Grok Bot usage records contain both a user principal and a team ID. The account can now display its confirmed weekly quota. - Leaves Codex automatic approval review to Codex. The HUD only handles a permission request when the matching turn explicitly uses a user reviewer. - Includes the LAN connection and cross-device sync fixes from the 0.4.39 release series.
## Known issues
- Grok prepaid and on-demand wallet amounts, including a zero-dollar wallet, are not yet displayed. The missing-quota placeholder also remains outstanding. [Issue #20](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/issues/20) remains open; [PR #35](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/pull/35) and [PR #38](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/pull/38) address native usage reading and personal-account recognition. - Cross-device features require iPhone 1.5 or later. Use the corresponding TestFlight build while version 1.5 is awaiting App Store review.

Build 482

# Agent HUD 0.5.0 ## Compatibility **Requires Agent HUD for iPhone 1.5 or later** for iPhone and Apple Watch sync. Update the iPhone app before updating the Mac. Older iPhone versions cannot read this release's data. [Get the iPhone app](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812113619). Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later. ## Changes - Adds Simple mode: a compact floating HUD on any screen edge, with quota rings, percentages, or both. Adjust its size and ring thickness in Display settings. Percentages use lighter Regular weight and stay in place as the panel opens. - Turns agent logos into animated bots while they work, ask for permission, or finish a reply. Their eyes follow the pointer, and idle logos occasionally visit as bots. Customize bot logos, dock logo size, and edge spacing; Reduce Motion keeps static logos. - Shows Codex Desktop Computer Use app-access requests on the HUD with the native Deny, Allow this conversation, and Always allow choices when available. Native answers and dismissals follow the original request; automatic engine review stays with Codex. - Displays unavailable Grok subscription quota as N/A while preserving known reset times. Shows prepaid balances and on-demand spending, including confirmed zero-dollar values, and keeps cache provenance in an information tooltip. - Refreshes signed-in accounts when Agents settings opens and offers Refresh accounts. Removes accounts a successful reading no longer reports, while retaining the last current identity during a failed reading. - Separates Grok CLI and Grok Bot execution clients while sharing quota for confirmed accounts. Uses native Bot quota readings with their original timestamps and recognizes personal SuperGrok accounts. Scheduled routine runs join their bot session; billing-only children keep their token accounting without cluttering session lists. - Groups sessions by Git project, including worktrees, and shows Codex child agents with their own task, workspace, state and token usage without recounting inherited history. - Prioritizes waiting and running work in the HUD, lists up to five recent sessions, and places them below Tokens. The token chart always shows the last 24 hours in 15-minute bars independently of Dashboard filters. Reply reminders have a close button that leaves permission requests unanswered. - Returns supported Grok sessions to their originating client and makes locally available Grok CLI, Grok Bot and Antigravity conversation text available on iPhone when sharing is enabled, preserving explicit gaps in cached Bot history. - Answers ZCode questions on the HUD and supports questions from compatible DeepSeek Harness web hosts. Codex hooks handle confirmed user review while leaving automatic or unknown reviewers unanswered. - Recovers cross-device publication after partial cloud-upload failures and keeps local-network readings consistent during refreshes. Caches recent conversation reads, resumes Codex transcripts incrementally, and avoids repeated record encoding during snapshot sorting.
